code:
def generate_image(prompt, **kwargs):
    from urllib.parse import quote
    url = f"https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{quote(prompt)}?width=1600&height=1200&nologo=poll&nofeed=yes"
    return f"IMAGE : ![{prompt}]({url})"
description: Create an image based on a text prompt.

prompt.description: The prompt describing the image to generate.
